answer: The rule groups identities by their behavioural signature and applies the penalty to the whole group at once. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. The canyon is the collateral at risk, the marble the behavioural signature that groups identities, and the voyage the joint forfeiture that punishes the group: splitting into many marble groups avoids the joint loss but scatters the canyon into smaller, individually useless stakes.
